reviews.comment: She kind of lied the week 1 by saying that was the hardest reading we would have to do, but the homework has gotten longer. On one hand, this is A&M, I should expect to be challenged. But on the other, I'm not even a history major, and I study way more for this than some of my major courses. However, I think Bouton is great at what she does.

Each class you have to complete assigned readings and answer questions. The readings are typically 20-40 pg long with 5-25 questions. This has to be done 3x a week! If you are not a test person, and are willing to put up with the work load, this is the class for you! The tests are 3 take home essays. She is a great prof, but the work is crazy.

She's very nice and friendly and will help you in anyway possible. For writing intensive course, you must do the readings and only way you can fail is if you fall back yourself. Not a hard class if you put some effort.
